title: Sweet Braised Pork Tostadas
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tostadas, this dish features tender braised pork and a blend of spices.
instructions: Season the pork chunks with oregano, cumin, and nutmeg.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork chunks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Return the pork to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Shred the pork with two forks and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the tostadas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tostadas by spooning the pork onto a tostada, topping with cheese, and serving immediately.
